label: Diagram 2.1
caption: Diagram 2.1 Means of escape from dwellinghouses
description:
This drawing comprises four labelled cross‑sectional diagrams, a to d, plus a legend, headed "See paras 2.1 to 2.6" and footed "Diagram 2.1 Means of escape from dwellinghouses". Diagrams c and d each show a house with "Unoccupied space" at the roof, a grey‑shaded column on the right, and green circle‑and‑line symbols ("Direction of escape") pointing right from each floor. Diagrams a and b also have green circle‑and‑line symbols pointing right from each floor.

a. "Single storey dwellinghouse (see paragraph 2.1)": one room, "Escape via entrance hall. Inner rooms provided with escape windows or doors."

b. "Dwellinghouse with upper storeys a maximum of 4.5m above ground level (see paragraphs 2.2 and 2.3)": two floors, dimensioned "4.5m max."; upper "Escape via stair and escape windows. Alternatively provide a protected stairway."; lower "Escape via entrance hall. Inner rooms provided with escape windows or doors."

c. "Dwellinghouse with one storey more than 4.5m above ground level (see paragraph 2.5)": three floors, dimensioned "4.5m"; protected stairway throughout, top "Escape via protected stairway. No inner rooms allowed.", middle "Escape via protected stairway. Inner rooms provided with escape windows.", bottom "Escape via entrance hall. Inner rooms provided with escape windows or doors."

d. "Dwellinghouse with two or more storeys more than 4.5m above ground level (see paragraph 2.6)": four floors, dimensioned "7.5m" and "4.5m"; top "Escape via protected stairway. Provide alternative escape route or sprinklers. No inner rooms allowed.", second "Escape via protected stairway. No inner rooms allowed.", third "Escape via protected stairway. Inner rooms provided with escape windows.", bottom "Escape via entrance hall. Inner rooms provided with escape windows or doors."

Legend: green circle‑and‑line symbol, "Direction of escape"; grey square, "Protected stairway (minimum REI 30)".
